_gpu_name_comment: MI400X (Helios platform, Pensando Vulcano NICs). gpu_name resolves nic_type to 'ainic' automatically; no Broadcom driver setup is performed.
_gpus_per_node_comment: MI400X ships 4 GPUs per node (unlike the 8 on MI300X/MI325X/MI355X); affects world size and tokens/s totals in test_training. gpus_per_node below is the single source of truth -- MegatronVariantConfig propagates it into container.env.GPUS_PER_NODE automatically, so it is intentionally omitted from container.env here. NOTE: container.env.GPUS is intentionally omitted, so DEFAULT_CONTAINER_ARGS (cvs/core/orchestrators/container.py) still injects the hardcoded GPUS=8 default into the container -- confirm the amdprimus image reads GPUS_PER_NODE (not GPUS) before relying on this.
_threshold_comment: enforce_thresholds=false (record-only): MI400X is unreleased hardware, so threshold_json below carries placeholder values copied from MI355X. Recalibrate on real MI400X runs before setting this true.
_primus_cli_overrides_comment: Optional, Primus images only. Extra primus-cli flags appended after the suite's own batch args, rendered space-separated as '--flag value' (a dict here, or a raw '--flag value ...' string for flags that don't fit that shape). Overlay a different value per sweep cell in the combination body if needed. Remove this key if your Primus image's default backend is already correct.
_smoke_comment: test_smoke loads the model and runs a small fixed cell without metric gating. enabled=false skips it.
_loss_curve_comment: sample training loss every `sample_every` steps (plus milestone_steps) and pass when the least-squares slope < max_slope. enforce=false makes it record-only.
_convergence_comment: to enable validation loss set --eval-interval > 0 and --eval-iters in megatron training args; this needs a validation data split in the dataset blend. target_value <= 0 disables convergence checking (record-only). target_metric 'auto' uses eval_loss when eval runs, else training loss.
_checkpoint_comment: save_interval controls checkpoint frequency (steps); save_iters is the step at which the save-phase run stops; resume_iters is the step at which the resume-phase run stops. Loss at resume_iters must match the save-phase loss within loss_rtol. enforce=false makes checkpoint testing record-only.
_sweep_comment: combination key is MBS=<mbs>,GBS=<gbs>,PRECISION=<precision> for that cell (body may overlay extras such as training_iterations). Omit sweep to run one default cell from train_params.
